facts.fact: The Civil Service Agency's 2024 annual report says payroll interventions removed duplicate National Identification Numbers, among other ineligible entries, from the government payroll.

The Civil Service Agency reports 5,536 employees removed from payroll from March to October 2024 (US$1.84m saved), and the IMF 3,775 removed, the figure covering ghost workers, double dippers, duplicate NINs and shared bank accounts together.
